metadata.title: The Library of Little Things
metadata.subtitle: Small Things, Big Adventures
metadata.author: Giggle & Snooze
metadata.blurb: At Bea’s library, you can borrow a stone, a whisk, or a star button. All you owe when you come back is a story.
metadata.dedication: For everyone who has ever found a treasure in their pocket.

style_bible.style_prompt_prefix: Original Giggle & Snooze pencil-and-brush illustration: distinctive asymmetric silhouettes, angular faces and varied proportions, warm expressive characters. Define each character by unique face geometry, hair silhouette, wardrobe and a signature detail; preserve these across pages. Confident imperfect graphite and coloured pencil with visible searching strokes, matte gouache and broken dry-brush edges on fresh light paper. Vibrant rich teal, coral, leaf green, copper, lilac, gold and plum adapted to the story; preserve natural skin tones. Avoid interchangeable round bean-shaped characters.

characters.name: Bea
characters.look: Bea is a tall, brown-skinned girl with a kite-shaped face and a high puff of black curls tilted left. She wears teal overalls over a cream shirt, with a copper key on a belt loop.

characters.name: Tavi
characters.look: Tavi is a short, wiry boy with freckled peach skin, a pointed chin, and a wedge of rust-red hair. He wears a leaf-green jacket with one gold elbow patch and brown shorts.

characters.name: Zella
characters.look: Zella is a broad-shouldered woman with deep brown skin, a square jaw, and a fan of short twists. She wears a coral cardigan over plum trousers and one large lilac bangle.

characters.name: Idris
characters.look: Idris is a lanky older man with warm olive skin, a long triangular face, and silver hair swept straight up. He wears a lilac vest, teal trousers, and gold half-moon glasses.

pages.title: Open at Last
pages.text: Bea opened a library on her front steps. On the shelf sat a smooth stone, a tiny whisk, and a button shaped like a star. “Borrow a little thing,” said Bea. “Bring back a story.”
pages.prompt: Bea flips the door sign to OPEN beside a low shelf holding a smooth gray stone, a tiny copper whisk, and a gold star button. Her teal overalls and copper key stand out against the coral front door. Tavi, Zella, and Idris lean in from the sidewalk in a staggered line, each looking at a different object. Morning light, leaf-green planters, and a clear lower margin.

pages.title: A Stone for a Boat
pages.text: Tavi borrowed the smooth stone. He brought it back warm from his pocket. “My paper boat kept tipping, so I gave it a stone to sit on. We sailed all the way to the far side of the puddle.”
pages.prompt: At the right of Bea’s front steps, Tavi offers Bea the gray stone and points at a puddle. A folded paper boat with a flat seat for the stone floats in the foreground. In the puddle’s reflection, the boat becomes a tall white sailing ship with a stone deck under billowing clouds. Keep the upper left quiet and pale for the text card.

pages.title: A Whisk for the Wind
pages.text: Zella borrowed the tiny whisk. She brought it back with a yellow ribbon tied to the handle. “I waved it to whisk up the wind. The wind lifted my kite right over the rooftops.”
pages.prompt: Zella holds out the tiny copper whisk with its yellow ribbon to Bea on the steps. The curling ribbon leads the eye up and right into Zella’s imagined gust, which lifts a long-tailed coral kite over uneven lilac roofs. Zella’s bangle catches the light as Bea looks up. Leave the bottom left open and calm for the text card.

pages.title: A Star for the Moon
pages.text: Idris borrowed the star button. He brought it back in his cupped hands. “I held it up when the moon looked lonely. Then I watched the whole sky fill with friends.”
pages.prompt: On the left, Idris bends to show Bea the gold star button in his cupped hands, his half-moon glasses slipping toward his nose. Above them, his remembered evening sky opens in soft plum and teal, with a pale moon and scattered little gold stars. Use a pale, open patch in the upper right for the text card.

pages.title: One More Story
pages.text: Bea put the three little things back on the shelf. “Borrow a little thing,” she said. Idris reached for the whisk, Zella took the stone, and Tavi picked up the star. “We’ll bring back a story,” they said.
pages.prompt: In warm late-afternoon light, Bea sits on the front step with room beside her. At the low shelf Idris reaches for the copper whisk with its yellow ribbon, Zella lifts the smooth stone, and Tavi pinches the gold star button between two fingers. Their faces turn toward one another mid-smile, with the coral door open behind Bea. Leave the lower margin clear.
